title: When bringing routines in from Hevy or Strong fails, nothing records why and the member has nowhere to turn
what: After a Hevy or Strong import, or from a Hevy share link, the routine steps end with Save. If saving fails the member reads 'Nothing was changed. Please try again.' (or that some new exercises were already added). The real error is thrown away without being written anywhere, and the screen offers no Help and feedback. Several earlier steps also swallow their errors: if the app cannot read which plan the member follows, it does not ask before switching their Up next to the new routines; if it cannot read the folders, the folder list is simply empty.
expected: The real error is kept (in the crash reports MettleUp reads), a repeat failure offers Help and feedback, and a failed read of the followed plan stops and says so rather than skipping the question.
who: members moving from Hevy or Strong
how_often: each time a routine save or a read fails
fix_line: Log the real error, add a Get help button after a repeat failure, and stop rather than skip the follow question when it cannot be read

title: Member help says nothing about swapping an exercise, demo data, easy weeks, strength level or trainer videos, and stops the Hevy import before the routine steps
what: The AI help answers only from the help articles. No member article mentions Swap an exercise, the Demo data strip and its Remove, Easy weeks, the strength level line, Watch your trainer videos, or set types beyond warm-up sets. The Hevy or Strong article ends at Merge or Replace, says nothing about the step-by-step routines that follow, the Up next switch or the 'From Hevy' folder, and says the file is not uploaded without saying a signed-in member's workouts are then copied to their MettleUp account. The help check only looks at screen files, so these parts can never trip it.
expected: Each of these parts has a short member article (or a line in the right one), and the help check also covers the shared parts the screens are built from.
how_often: whenever a member asks about these parts
fix_line: Add the missing member articles and extend the help check to the shared parts

items.reason: Moving in is the Hevy or Strong routine steps (failure not recorded); set-up is the demo strip, whose failed Remove is logged and told; offboarding is the gym plan that ends; no billing in this area.
Every failure here (share picture, demo remove, workout photo, easy weeks, strength choice) is written only to the phone's own log, so nothing reaches the owner's daily view; already found.
Rest timer, weekly goal and RPE articles match the screens; swap, demo, easy weeks, strength level, trainer video and the Hevy routine steps have no help.
This area has no contact-us path of its own; its failure notices say only try again, with no Help and feedback.

Install on watch sends every member to the Play watch app, which only pairs with the Play-signed phone app (already found). Gym logos load through the app's own server addresses; trainer videos depend on YouTube links the gym gave. No key or token is held in this area.
